messages.subject: GCC Power & Infrastructure Executive | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Sunil,

Power & Water Talent Solutions' GCC focus across power, utilities and infrastructure makes this a relevant introduction for senior regional mandates.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications, with direct exposure to large-scale renewable-energy and battery-storage investment.

I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional leadership appointments where infrastructure growth, government engagement, regulatory strategy, sustainability performance and stakeholder confidence must work together. Saudi Arabia is my first-priority market, followed by the UAE and wider GCC, and I am internationally mobile for expatriate appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration for appropriate current or future searches.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
Georgetown, Guyana
